algorithm: Perform a BFS traversal of the graph starting from each unvisited node.
Track visited nodes and build components as we traverse the graph.
Ensure components are internally sorted and the outer list is lexicographically sorted.
constraints: Edges are distinct and represent a simple undirected graph.
Vertices are numbered from 0 to n-1.
The graph is undirected and unweighted.
Components are returned as internally sorted lists, with the outer list lexicographically sorted.
edge_cases: When the graph has a single node with no edges (connected component of size 1).
When the graph has no edges (all nodes are isolated).
When the graph is disconnected (multiple components).
parsed.inputs: n is an integer >= 1; edges is a list of distinct [u, v] pairs with 0 <= u < v < n.
parsed.output: A list of sets, where each set represents a connected component of the graph.
parsed.purpose: Generate connected components of an undirected graph.
